title: Coarse-to-fine crack cue for robust crack detection (CrackCue)
mechanism: Max-pool (k=8) plus upsample erases thin dark cracks; a skip-free encoder-decoder trained only on non-crack pixels refines this into a crack-free background; abs(image minus background) is concatenated as an extra input channel to any segmenter.
evidence: R: cross-dataset (train CrackTree, test 3 sets) ODS +5.7% U-Net, +7.6% CrackFormer, +4.2% DeepCrack; under defocus blur U-Net+CrackCue avg ODS 0.795 vs 0.739 (LIOT 0.723); under contrast perturbation 0.842 vs 0.668. Ablation: median and black-hat cues help moderately, Canny hurts.
adaptation: Learned golden cell for EL: mask crack (dilated to 5 px to cover the 4 px FWHM) and inactive from the reconstruction loss; keep k=8 at 512 px (also try 12); fingers, busbars and grain texture stay in the loss so the cue learns to suppress them; 2-channel input with conv1 channel 2 initialised from the mean ImageNet filter. Risk: scuff streaks on E1 are dark and unseen, so the cue may fire on them.
min_experiment: Arm: house U-Net++ + background net + cue channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: house (PF for E1 inactive). Metrics: test-clean crack IoU and relF1@2; E1 crack relF1@2 and recall in half-cut cells. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 and test crack IoU gain < +0.012.
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF 5 tried intensity normalisation and BN adaptation at inference, not a learned background-difference input channel.

alt_notes.adaptation: Mask crack and inactive (crack dilated to about 5 px, matching the 4 px dark-line FWHM) from the reconstruction loss so fingers, busbars and grain are learned as background; k=8 at 512 px (try 12); 2-channel input with conv1 channel 2 initialised from the mean ImageNet filter; watch E1 precision because scuff streaks are absent from training and may light up the cue.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + background net + |I-B| channel, joint loss weight 1, 5 seeds. Baseline: house U-Net++. Metrics: test-clean crack IoU and relF1@2, E1 crack relF1@2 and recall in the 20 scuff half-cut cells. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 AND test crack IoU gain < +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: EL cracks are thin and darker, matching the prior. Dilate crack labels to about 5 px (4 px FWHM) and also mask inactive in the recon loss. Fingers and busbars are thin dark lines too, so the recon net must learn to rebuild them; inspect cue maps on mono vs multi and half-cut cells before training. Feed (EL, cue) as 2 channels to U-Net++ PF.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF U-Net++ with 2-channel (EL, cue) input, recon net trained per fold; plus a LIOT-input arm. Baseline: PF. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall, module-grouped 5-fold CV crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or CV crack IoU drops > 0.01. 3 seeds per arm.

alt_notes.adaptation: EL cracks are thin and darker than context, so the prior fits. Dilate crack labels to about 5 px (FWHM 4 px) and also mask inactive in the recon loss. Fingers and busbars are thin dark lines too, so the recon net must rebuild them; inspect cue maps on mono, multi and half-cut scuffed pool cells first. Cue becomes a second input channel to U-Net++ PF.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: 2-channel (EL, cue) U-Net++ PF, recon net trained per fold; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall, CV crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or CV crack IoU drops > 0.01. Add a LIOT input arm in the same batch.

alt_notes.adaptation: 1-ch EL + cue as 2-ch input to house U-Net++ (conv1 widened, weights copied). Mask crack and gridline (dilated to 5 px) in the reconstruction loss. Start with the zero-parameter coarse cue, pool k in {4,6,8} since crack FWHM is about 4 px and fingers 2-3 px. Expect the cue to also fire on fingers and E1 scuff streaks: a chance for gridline recall and a risk for crack precision.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + coarse cue channel, 5 seeds, 20k steps; baseline: house 5 seeds (PF variant as second pair for E1). Select on val+F51, score test clean-49 and E1. Metrics: crack relF1@2, crack IoU, gridline IoU, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03 and test relF1@2 not up, or test crack IoU drop > 0.012.
